fields.description: Rivera is a collection of four bedroom homes at The Valley Phase 2. Emaar’s detailed drawings identify semi-detached villas in Magnolia, Lotus and Lavender designs. Family living extends from a ground-floor kitchen and dining space to an upper lounge and terrace, with landscape and recreation at the centre of the community plan.

overview: Rivera’s emphasis is on time outdoors: trails, an orchard and flower-farm setting, places for children to explore and a pool for the community. The brochure describes three façade styles and interiors in natural, earthy tones. It presents Rivera as The Valley’s first LEED neighbourhood; that is the developer’s stated positioning, not an independently verified certification or a promise of particular utility savings.
research.locationNote: Rivera is within The Valley Phase 2, along Dubai–Al Ain Road. The community connects by road towards central Dubai and Dubai Outlet Mall. Travel estimates vary between launch documents; check the actual route and peak-time journey before choosing a home.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises a starting price of AED 4.78 million. The launch fact sheet uses the same figure. Neither establishes current availability or the price of a particular home; obtain an up-to-date quotation.
research.paymentNote: The Emaar-branded launch schedule is 10% on booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Property Finder instead lists 10/80/10. The dated launch document is shown here, with the discrepancy left open for confirmation against the sale agreement.
research.handoverNote: Rivera’s launch payment and fact sheets estimate construction completion in June 2029. Property Finder lists November 2028, so dates are not consistent across sources. June 2029 is shown as reported, pending written developer confirmation.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The launch fact sheet lists 378 four bedroom homes. This is the planned collection size, not the number currently available. Its community map also identifies adventure play, river viewpoints, wadi walks and a scooter pump track.

facts.label: Space inside and outside
facts.value: Suites are 2,846.41–2,857.28 sq ft; the published totals add a 445.63 sq ft garage and 396.22–411.18 sq ft balcony area. Plot area is not supplied in the reviewed plan table.

facts.label: Three-level arrangement
facts.value: Plans show a ground-floor guest bedroom and maid’s room, three bedrooms above, and a second-floor lounge opening to a terrace. Check the exact selected variant and final drawing.
